title: Kestrel and the Gravity
author: R. M. Thornbury
blurb: Noor Thornbury, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
